aboutParas: The ProffMusic boutique is kept by Kotsart HayprofFlex — the composer his circle simply calls Prof. His melodies are born in silence and settle into their purpose the way rare meteorites settle into an open palm: weightlessly and forever.

Every piece here is a living instrument, recorded with no intermediaries between soul and sound. Some tracks stir the body, making the pulse beat in time; others fortify the spirit, gathering scattered thoughts into a single line.
Prof works without haste and without formulas. If the finished sound is not there yet — he will compose it for you personally, from the first idea to the final pause.
licenseParas: Every purchase in the boutique is a commercial license between you and the keeper of the boutique. It grants the right to use the track in your works: video, advertising, podcasts, games and other projects.
Allowed: use the track in commercial and non-commercial projects without per-view fees; monetise content on any platform; make reasonable modifications — tempo, key, editing.
Not allowed: resell the track as a standalone product, pass it off as your own composition, or distribute the raw audio file without a purchase.
The license is perpetual and takes effect upon payment. If you need non-standard use — write to the creator personally.

articles.title: Why melodies stir the body: the physiology of sound
articles.lead: Before a melody touches the spirit, it passes through the body. Sound is a wave, and that wave washes over every cell.
body: Sound is not an abstraction and not an ornament. It is air pressure that reaches us in waves and makes the eardrum tremble. From there the tremor passes into the cochlea of the inner ear, and from it into the nerves that lead straight to the heart of the brain.

The body responds before the mind can formulate a thought. A fast tempo quickens the pulse, low frequencies hum in the chest, high ones raise goosebumps. Thus melody speaks to us without words, in the language of physiology itself.
That is why some tracks instantly lift the mood, while others make us freeze. Not because we decided to react that way: the body has already answered, and we are merely catching up with awareness.

When the master composes music, he works with this ancient mechanism carefully. First the pulse, then the order, and only then the meaning. Thus is born a melody that stirs not only the mind but every cell of the body.

articles.title: Music and the spirit: how sound fortifies the spirit
articles.lead: If the body is the instrument on which sound plays, then the spirit is the one who listens and gathers what is heard into will.
body: Music has two tasks. The first is to wake the body, the second is to gather scattered thoughts into a single line. When we listen, the chaos of the day gradually settles into rhythm, and the spirit finds its footing.
This is the ancient secret of marches and hymns: sound organised into order passes its orderliness to the listener. The even step of a row, the majestic melody — and inner turmoil retreats.

That is what the boutique exists for: not only for celebration, but for quiet support. A melody that sounds in a hard hour is like a reliable shoulder: it reminds us that order is possible and purpose is achievable.
Listen carefully, and you will notice: after good music the spirit stands a little straighter than before. This is not magic — it is order. And order, as is well known, fortifies.

articles.title: Silence as material: the pauses between notes
articles.lead: A melody is made not only of notes but of the silence between them. A pause is not emptiness — it is the master's most sensitive instrument.
body: A beginner thinks music is sounds. The master knows: music is the decision of where a sound should ring out and where it should fall silent. The silence between notes is as much a material as timbre or tempo.
A pause gives the sound time to settle in memory. Without it a melody becomes a running line without punctuation; with it — live speech where every word is heard.
In silence expectation is born, and expectation makes sound more precious. That pause before the climax, when everything freezes, is not emptiness. It is the breath before the leap.

Prof works with silence as with a precious material. He knows: if you do not give the listener a moment of silence, he will not hear the note either. Therefore in his melodies the pauses stand where they are meant to stand — and ring louder than many chords.

articles.title: Rarity as value: why meteorite tracks are priceless
articles.lead: There is no streaming feed in the boutique: every track is a one-off, like a meteorite that fell to you in particular.
body: Rarity is not an artificial scarcity. It is a property of a thing made by hand, without a conveyor belt and without repeats. The master could compose a hundred similar melodies, but he composes one — the very one.
Thus every track in the boutique is like a meteorite: it has no serial number and no clone. It travelled from intent to sound once, and that path will never repeat.

The value of such a thing is not in the price tag but in the uniqueness of the moment. You are not buying a file — you are buying a rare sound that will not be met anywhere else. And it stays yours forever.
That is why the license here is perpetual: a rare thing should not have an expiration date. It passes to you as a meteorite passes from the sky into a palm — weightlessly and forever.

articles.title: How to order a melody from the master: from intent to sound
articles.lead: If the sound you need is not in the catalog, it can be ordered. The path from intent to melody is shorter than it seems.
body: It all begins with a letter. Tell the master: what the music is for — a video, a podcast, a ceremony or a game; what mood should live in it; what instruments you hear; and by what deadline you need the sound.
The master listens to every word and responds: clarifies, suggests, tunes in to your intent. Sometimes three phrases are enough to hear the future melody.
Then comes the silence of work. A melody is born in silence, as it should be — and one day it arrives ready, from the first entrance to the final pause.
Write to Prof at the email on the 'Contact the Creator' page. He answers himself, with no intermediaries — and perhaps the next melody of your project will be born precisely in that correspondence.

rulesParas: The boutique is open to everyone who seeks a rare sound. Few but firm rules apply here, so that the catalog stays clean and communication stays respectful.
The content of the site — covers, titles, descriptions and texts — belongs to the keeper of the boutique. Do not copy it without permission and do not pass it off as your own.
Tracks may be listened to for preview and purchased for use. Circumventing protection or attempting to obtain a file bypassing purchase violates the rules and terminates access to the boutique.
In communication with the creator and other collectors, keep the order: no rudeness, spam or off-topic content. Violators lose access without warning.
The rules may be refined; all changes are published on this page and take effect upon publication.
privacyParas: The boutique collects only the data needed for the purpose: name, email and order details. Nothing extra — following the master's principle of never adding a single unnecessary note.
Email is used to deliver the track, confirm the purchase and answer letters. Order processing keeps purchase history so you can return to your tracks.
We do not sell or pass your data to third parties. Payment data is processed by the payment service directly — the boutique never sees or stores it.
The site may use standard technical analytics tools that help understand which pages are useful. They do not collect personal information about you.
If you have questions about data — write to the creator at shop{'@'}proffmusic.shop, and he will answer personally.
gdprParas: If you are in the European Economic Area, the data protection law (GDPR) grants you specific rights regarding your data. The boutique honours them in full.
You have the right to access your data, correct inaccuracies and delete your account along with order history if it is no longer needed.
You have the right to restrict processing, object to it and receive your data in a portable format. To do so write to shop{'@'}proffmusic.shop — the request is fulfilled within 30 days.
If you believe your rights have been violated, you may lodge a complaint with the data protection authority of your country.
Data is kept only as long as needed for the boutique to work: while the account lives or while the law requires keeping purchase records.
legal.termsTitle: Terms of Sale of Digital Goods
termsParas: A purchase in the boutique is the transfer of a digital good: the audio file and a perpetual license for its use, as described on the 'License' page.
After payment you receive a download link. The link is valid for a limited time and is available in your profile — save the file once received.

Digital goods are not subject to return after download, as is proper for sound you have already received. If the file is corrupted or the purchase was not delivered — write to the creator, and he will make it right personally.
Use of the track is governed by the license: you purchase the right to apply the music in your projects, not to resell it as a standalone product.
Payment is processed by the payment service; the boutique does not store payment data. Prices are shown in the catalog and may change, but the price of your order is fixed at the moment of payment.
